model_output.verdict: An IT support resume with practical help desk work, but no activity dated after 2025.
write_up: Your resume points toward desktop support, with a help desk internship at Chattahoochee County Schools and device setup work at Peachtree Electronics. A recruiter can see the work you did, but the latest role doesn't say how much you handled, and nothing accounts for your time after 2025. That's likely to lead to a pass for now.

This is common on an early-career IT resume: the tasks are real, but the details that distinguish them are still missing. Your Active Directory line is a good model because it names both the account work and the tool. Put Experience above Education so the school help desk work is visible sooner.
